audit.why: Both layers give Skill / Skill / Sejuani / Skill / Skill / Sejuani / Skill, which matches the packet stage read and a 52.11% matchup over 190 games. No change needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike claimed Glacial Prison is a CC opener 'he cannot dodge', and the first-item spike described 'his Unstoppable Onslaught charge into a Q-W-E-R sequence', which reads as his ult inside your combo.
audit.why: Glacial Prison is a projectile — it stuns the first champion hit at 1300 range. Sion is slow enough that it is reliable, which is the honest reason, not undodgeability. The first-item spike also ignored the real change at that timing.
audit.corrected: Level 6 restated as a 1300-range projectile stun on the first champion hit; first-item spike rewritten around Soul Furnace's percent max health damage and Grievous Wounds for the zombie passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Roar of the Slayer's armour shred and minion knock-back, Soul Furnace's percent max health damage, and Glory in Death's healing were absent from every field.
audit.why: Soul Furnace deals magic damage scaled to max health and Glory in Death heals off rapid attacks, so pure armour stacking reads this matchup wrong and un-shredded healing outlasts your cooldowns. Roar of the Slayer also knocks a minion back into you, shredding armour on everyone it passes.
audit.corrected: Armour shred and buying HP alongside resists written into the Levels 4-5 phase and the first-item spike; Grievous Wounds for the zombie passive written into late; the E minion knock-back and his R cutting retreat written into wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states whether Permafrost or Glacial Prison can stop Unstoppable Onslaught.
audit.why: Riot's description does not say, and Sejuani's kit file marks tenacity, cleanse and interrupt eligibility as unknown. I will not assert it either way.
audit.corrected: Left alone; recorded in unverified and in questionsForUser.

edits.after: Both are weak at 1 and Decimating Smash telegraphs — take W, last-hit, and deny him a free shove.
edits.before: One of the weakest level 1s in top lane — take W, hit the wave, last-hit, and give absolutely nothing.

edits.after: Q online gives you an exit — threaten a knock-up trade only when his charged Q is visibly down.
edits.before: Q online gives you an exit — use it to leave fights, not to start them, until your tank stats exist.

edits.after: Full kit: W-W into E Permafrost is your trade — land it once Soul Furnace is spent, never into a fresh shield.
edits.before: Full kit: W-W into E Permafrost is your trade — land it on his step-up and walk before his counter-pattern starts.

edits.after: Frost stacks decide every trade: fight only when the full Q-W-E chain is available. Roar of the Slayer shreds armour, so buy health too.
edits.before: Frost stacks decide every trade: fight only when the full Q-W-E chain is available. Track Decimating Smash (Stun) before stepping up.

edits.after: Glacial Prison online — a 1300-range stun on the first champion hit opens him before his Q can charge.
edits.before: Glacial Prison online — every jungle visit is now a guaranteed CC chain. Your lane becomes a gank magnet.

edits.after: Sunfire ends the squishy phase, but Soul Furnace burns max health through it.
edits.before: First tank item ends the squishy phase — you stop losing the trades your stun starts.

edits.after: Bank R for their carries — spent on Sion it only feeds a zombie that still contests the pit.
edits.before: You're a teamfight engine now — the lane barely matters if your R hits two people at the dragon pit.

edits.after: Glacial Prison at Level 6 is a 1300-range projectile stunning the first champion hit, and Sion is too slow to sidestep it — chain E on landing.
edits.before: Glacial Prison at Level 6 gives you a ranged CC opener he cannot dodge — chain E stun immediately on landing for a legitimate kill threat.

edits.after: Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel widens the trade gap, but Soul Furnace burns percent max health straight through your armour — buy health alongside resists and bring Grievous Wounds for his zombie passive.
edits.before: Sunfire Aegis or Heartsteel dramatically widens the damage-per-trade gap — his Unstoppable Onslaught charge into a Q-W-E-R sequence now threatens a kill that low items couldn't close.

edits.after: Knock a minion into you with Roar of the Slayer for the armour shred, then cut your retreat with Unstoppable Onslaught
edits.before: Survive lane passively, scale into zombie passive value at objectives, and force teamfights where his front-line bulk matches yours

edits.after: Both of you become near-unkillable 1v1 and your value shifts entirely into teamfight CC output. Your job is Glacial Prison onto their backline carries — not trading with Sion, who will zombie-passive through it and hand his team a free objective contest. Glory in Death heals him off every rapid attack, so somebody has to carry Grievous Wounds into the pit or the second life outlasts your cooldowns. Respect Unstoppable Onslaught at the objective: it cuts retreats, so hold Flash for the wall. Win by engaging squishies, not by out-tanking the tank.
edits.before: Both of you become near-unkillable 1v1 and your value shifts entirely into teamfight CC output. Your job is Glacial Prison onto their backline carries — not trading with Sion, who will zombie-passive through the trade and give his team a free objective contest window. Respect his zombie state at dragon and baron; if you burn your R to kill him and he activates passive, your team has no CC answer to his second life. Win by being the better engager onto squishies, not by trying to out-tank the tank.

notes: Sion's damage profile was missing from both layers: Soul Furnace is percent max health magic damage and Glory in Death heals off rapid attacks, so the standing 'stack your passive resistances' advice reads the matchup wrong. Added health alongside resists and Grievous Wounds for the zombie window. Also fixed 'a CC opener he cannot dodge' — Glacial Prison is a projectile; the honest reason it lands on Sion is that he is slow. UNVERIFIED, LEFT IN PLACE: nothing in Riot's text says whether Permafrost or Glacial Prison interrupts Unstoppable Onslaught, and Sejuani's kit file lists interrupt and tenacity eligibility as unknown, so I did not write a claim either way. Separately, MC_WR_TABLES on disk lists this matchup at 50.18% over 1140 games while my packet says 52.11% over 190 — I did not touch the table, but the two disagree.
